designDecisions.fileTriad: Following the maxImperviousCoverPct precedent exactly (F-01 pattern: <rail>FactRead.ts for types + notCutOver refusal, <rail>FactFromParcelRecord.ts for the parcel_record adapter, <rail>ServeCutover.ts for the allowlist-gated wrapper) for all 5 new rails: parcelAreaSqFt, maxHeightFt, maxLotCoveragePct, maxFootprintSqFt (scalar pattern, near-identical to maxImperviousCoverPct's own triad) and setbackRules (companion-row pattern, modeled on utilityServiceFactFromParcelRecord.ts's own shape since that is this repo's only existing companion-row-sourced 'present' adapter).
designDecisions.noLegacyPath: Confirmed by repo-wide grep (matching S4's own CP2 method) -- none of the 5 rail names appear in any legacy read path anywhere in artifacts/api-server/src outside nodeFacetBakeTier1/Tier2 (which compute the UNRELATED bake-time envelope fields buildableAreaSqFt/buildableAreaPct/envelopeStatus/envelopeDisclosure -- confirmed distinct rail keys, not a namespace collision) and buildableEnvelope/* (same bake-time family, also distinct). All 5 wrappers therefore resolve 'not record' to a typed not-cut-over refusal, never a legacy fallback -- matching utilityService/overlayDistricts/agValuation/schoolDistrict/maxImperviousCoverPct/valueHistory's own established contract, not setbacks/zoning's (which DO have a bake-time legacy value to fall back to).
designDecisions.wiringTargets: Both brokerageNodeFacets.ts (Promise.all block ~line 773, response object ~line 850) and propertyExplorer.ts's assembleFullBody (Promise.all ~line 241, response object ~line 332) -- the two live consumer routes L1's audit confirmed mounted into the app, matching every existing root-sibling fact's (utilityServiceFact, overlayDistrictsFact, etc.) own wiring exactly. assembleStubBody (propertyExplorer.ts ~line 395) is NOT touched -- it does not carry the existing single-rail root siblings either (only flood/zoning/setbacks), so adding these 5 there would be new scope beyond parity with the existing pattern.
